commitResults.messageBody:
Task descriptions and completion states are managed separately in Dog,
which makes the data easy to desynchronize and leaves task behavior in the
command loop.

Introduce Task to own its description and completion state. Move both Java
classes into the dog package and update the run instructions to match. This
keeps each task's data and behavior together while satisfying the project
coding standard.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add SE-EDU Java coding standard skill
commitResults.messageBody:
Java changes need a consistent project-wide convention, but the rules are
not available to the agent between tasks.

Add a project-specific skill summarizing the authoritative SE-EDU rules and
mandate its use in AGENTS.md. This keeps future Java work consistent while
linking back to the maintained source.

Commit messages and branch names need consistent conventions across future
work.

Add a project-specific skill summarizing the SE-EDU Git rules and mandate its
use in AGENTS.md. This makes focused, reviewable history the default for
future repository changes.
